c74object.name: evi_classic_osc
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A selection of 'classic' oscillator shapes
c74object.description:
evi_classic_osc is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_classic_osc.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_polyblep.genexpr, evi_polyblep_two.genexpr, evi_polyblep_utility.genexpr
evi_classic_osc is also available in MSP as: evi.classic.osc~.
Provides classic oscillator shapes (sine, tri, saw, rect) using a 2-point polyblep algorithm. Optionally including PWM versions (@type attribute). Also offers high frequency loss compensation filters and rudimentary oversampling. An experimental dynamic DC control is included, allowing for simultaneous use as LFOs and audio rate oscillators.

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: in Hz. Oscillator frequency in Hz.

geninlet.name: pulse
geninlet.digest: Width 0..1 if type attr == 1 @default 0.5 @min 0 @max 1. PWM 0..1 if @type attribute set to on (1).

geninlet.name: sync
geninlet.digest: Phasor @default 0 @min 0 @max 1. External sync for internal oscillator sync. Note this is not fully implemented yet and might not be anti-aliased.

attribute.name: compensate
attribute.description: High frequency (decorrelation) compensation filters, 0=off, 1=1st order, 2=2nd order. This can account for high frequency loss due to anti-aliasing, e.g. restore brightness to the top end.

attribute.name: dc
attribute.description: Select DC behaviour. DC Blocking can be optionally dynamic. 0=off (no dc blocking, e.g. if only using at LFO rates), 1=on (standard dc blocking, if only using as audio rate oscillators), 2=auto for lfos (if using dynamically < 20Hz and < 4kHz), 3=auto for oscillators (if using < 20Hz and > 4kHz). Ultimately, the usefulness and effectiveness of this will vary depending on use case, and should be considered somewhat experimental.

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: The oversampling is not very good and not very useful. It will be updated in a future version of evieve. 0=1x, 1=2x (default), 2=4x, 3=8x.

attribute.name: type
attribute.description: If @type is on (1) the waveshapes switch to a dynamic version that accepts pulse width control. If off (0, the default), the waveshape is a static version only.
